## Activity

During December 2020, West Gate Eye Clinic completed 229 captures. Activity was delivered in line with the planned service arrangements. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, with no other operational issues recorded in the report.

The completed captures represent the imaging activity undertaken at the site during the month. The available activity information indicates that the clinic maintained its planned schedule while accommodating routine staff leave.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 13 were ungradable. This corresponds to an ungradable rate of 5.7. The result should be considered alongside the overall capture volume and the grading outcomes for the month. The report identifies image quality as an area for continued monitoring through routine review of capture and grading processes.

## Grading

A total of 53 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1 day. This indicates that grading was completed promptly during December 2020, notwithstanding the routine leave noted in the activity report.

Together, the activity, image quality and grading figures provide the operational summary for West Gate Eye Clinic for December 2020.
